title: Connected Nations Summer 2023 - About this data: Fixed coverage, local and unitary authority area
findings: Ofcom states that in the originally published ZIP file (r01), the coverage-availability file for all premises was a copy of the residential-premises file.
Ofcom states that the incorrect all-premises file was replaced by the correct file.
Ofcom states that both files were renamed as r02 for consistency.
The corrected all-premises local/unitary-authority file is documented as 202305_fixed_laua_coverage_r02.csv.
The residential local/unitary-authority file is documented as 202301_fixed_laua_res_coverage_r02.csv.
relevance_to_first_missing_criterion: Official historical correction/versioning precedent only: it demonstrates Ofcom's r01-to-r02 correction convention for a Connected Nations fixed-coverage ZIP. It does not establish the Spring 2026 corrected-r2 archive bytes, CRCs, exact 2026 member names, or content.
